key.name: panel-orb
key.description: When the top-bar orb shows: always (the idle orb when Voxtype is idle), only while Voxtype is busy, or never.

key.name: show-pill
key.description: Show the pill at the top centre of the screen while Voxtype is busy.

key.name: pill-monitor
key.description: The monitor the pill appears on: the one with the focused window, or the primary one.

key.name: mic-hints
key.description: Show "Can't hear you" and "No signal" in the pill. Off keeps "Listening…".

key.name: receipt
key.description: Show "Done" or "Nothing heard" in the pill after transcribing.

key.name: still-seconds
key.description: Seconds of transcribing before the pill says "Still transcribing…".

key.name: motion
key.description: Follow GNOME's animation setting, or always show still frames, with no fades and an instant hand-off.

key.name: menu-controls
key.description: Show Start dictation, Stop and transcribe and Cancel in the top-bar menu. They run "voxtype record" when chosen.
